d:
Anant sinh ki beti shivangi ki shadi ke samaroh men unke hone vale damad rishikesh kumar ne jan suraj neta anuj sinh se mulakat ki.
Is dauran rishikesh ne anuj sinh ke pair chhukar aashirvad liya, jiske bad anuj sinh ne unhen uphar bhi diya.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
